# Avloryn Labs

> Avloryn Labs LLP is an independent software product company based in India that builds
> intelligent software products designed to simplify work and help people focus on what
> matters. Its first product is LivoDraft.

## Products

- [LivoDraft](https://livodraft.com/): LivoDraft turns a student's own research into a
  submission-ready, India-format thesis, dissertation, research paper or review. It reads your
  topic, objectives, methodology, findings and up to ~100 of your own reference PDFs, then writes
  a complete multi-chapter draft of 8–300 pages across 9+ document types and cites it with real
  DOI-verified references (Crossref) in 6 styles. Formatting is UGC/AICTE/Shodhganga-compliant and
  degree-aware, delivered as an editable Word (.docx) file plus LaTeX/Overleaf and Shodhganga
  export. The "Make It Yours" workspace guides you to rewrite generic passages in your own words,
  and a fidelity-enforcer keeps your real data exact so it never invents your results. An honest AI
  research-to-thesis assistant with an AI-use disclosure certificate — not a detector-evasion tool.
  Made by Avloryn Labs.
